boundaries.venv_sizes: regular-file logical bytes after install, before tests; excludes symlink targets
boundaries.cache: separate empty uv cache per sample, OS/CDN cache not controlled
boundaries.shared_runtime: Python executable, stdlib, source acquisition excluded
boundaries.overlap: another repository installation may overlap final nano sample

output_parity.method: For each sorted tests/cases/pages/*.json, call accessible_names.observe, emoji_observations.observe and heading_observations.observe with html and url; serialize rows (input path, observer module name, output) with json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) plus newline.
